notes.content:
Steam: Rails to Riches is joining another exciting edition of the Turn-Based Carnival!

This event is a tribute to the games that make us think, plan, and savor every move. It's a chance to celebrate the creativity, depth, and diversity of turn-based gameplay. 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/96dad9192d8cbcd0dc58b95033113ed9362507dd.png

But that’s not all!

We have some exciting news to share! Alongside the Turn-Based Carnival, we are proud to announce our first original game - Inkborn, a roguelike deckbuilder that takes players on a dynamic, strategic journey unlike anything you've experienced before. Set to release on Early Access in Q2 2025! 🖋️

What sets Inkborn apart? 🃏
Inkborn features an innovative combo system where players discover powerful moves by playing cards in specific sequences, reminiscent of classic fighting game combos but with a unique twist. Our original Origami art style and evolving roster of character classes make every run feel unique. At launch, players can experiment with over 100 kinds of cards, and we'll be expanding the game with more characters, cards, and features leading up to the Full Release in Q2 2026. 🎮

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to embark on an unforgettable journey of intricate folds and strategic choices. Add Inkborn to your wishlist and follow to stay in the loop! 👇

notes.title: Add K2: Digital Edition To Your Wishlist!
notes.content:
We would like to proudly announce that we've become the official publishers of an exciting upcoming digital board game adaptation developed by our friends at Devon Games! 🤝

K2: Digital Edition brings the thrill of climbing K2 - Earth’s second-highest and one of the most dangerous mountains - right to your screen. Compete against AI with 3 difficulty levels, challenge your friends in real-time or asynchronous multiplayer, test your skills in a fast-paced single-player campaign or face the journey alone. 🧭 The game is easy to learn but hard to survive, offering a gripping and fun experience. Check the weather forecast regularly to adjust for freezing and severe conditions, and aim for the right weather window to set up your camp. 🏔️

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition Salsa DLC is out!
notes.content:
The long awaited first major DLC for Concordia: Digital Edition is now available for purchase! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/ace1ce32219990cb0b05c28ed1f4c5063a536072.jpg
 
As of now you can access Salt and Forum modules, and Hispania and Byzantium maps on iOS, Android, Steam, and GOG!

Salt is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png

Forum is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png

Hispania & Byzantium are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png

Last call for the tournament!

Don't forget you can still sign up for the Concordia: Digital Edition Online Tournament!
 
All you need is the base game of Concordia and the will to compete! The event is completely free of charge and there are real prizes to be won provided by us (Acram Digital) and PD-Verlag - the publisher of the tabletop Concordia! 

More information here.

notes.title: Concordia: Digital Edition - Salsa DLC releasing on the 01/27/22
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/a8a9b793b844bb91609911503d56995239b1554f.jpg

Big news for all you Concordia fans! 

The first of the three big DLC pieces is releasing next week - on the 27th of January 2022!

Salsa introduces two modules - Salt trading good, and Forum mechanic, and two more additional maps - Hispania and Byzantium!

Salt is a new kind of trading good that can not be bought or sold - it can only be acquired from Salt producing cities. It's also the most valuable of all the trading goods, as it can serve as any other good for the purposes of house construction or points scoring!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/0d91ee370eba5be96bfa58b32c3b4ecd4c70ebc9.png

Forum is a mechanic bringing a whole new set of Forum Cards, where you get patricians and regular citizens to help you throughout the game. The bonuses they provide are either a one-time use powerful ability or an ongoing change to core game mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/30956dab5c2f60887dfd374f4412f7011e06a78e.png

Hispania & Byzantium are the two maps that come with the Salsa DLC. They don't bring any new mechanics by themselves, but the different layout in itself will significantly impact the gameplay and the tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/6bda6cb100f1ac2cea9273c71529f313963bcdd4.png

Salsa DLC has been in beta testing for a while now - both by the dedicated beta testers as well as the Season Pass owners who chose to try and err the beta content. 

And if you're excited about trying content early - you still can! The Season Pass owners, regardless of platform, can always opt in and out of the beta content and try the DLCs mechanics and maps a bit ahead of time!

Add Salsa to your wishlist today!

notes.title: The most important vote in Concordia: Digital Edition
notes.content:
Old versus new, classic vs revamped - join us in the Concordia: Digital Edition group for the most important vote yet - and make your voice heard!

The group for Concordia: Digital Edition was made so that you, the players, had the opportunity to tell us, the developers, what you expect from the game. We’ve asked questions there, ran polls and taken many a sip from the proverbial well of knowledge that is the user feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38967994/d5487981db438d643f5820867cd0a861221682e9.gif

But now is the time for the most important vote yet. Above you can see two approaches to the visual style of the game. Our initial designs to the right and the new approach to the left.
 
We do have our favorite, but it’s not about us - it’s about you. So join the Concordia: Digital Edition group now, vote, and let us know which one YOU think is better (and why).

Share your tghoughts with us!

notes.title: Golden Train Edition
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Easter promotion is available - a special package: Golden Train Edition, which includes the main application and all the additional maps in one bundle.

There are also some bug fixes:
- fixed bug when rail/city hex tile was dragged out of map’s borders from legal position,
- fixed rare bug occurring in multiplayer game, when one of players abandons the game during build tracks phase,
- fixed rare bug that made lack of player’s token on rails on expansion maps,
- more minor bug fixes and improvements: tutorial, bidding in basic mode and other.
